newsitem.title: UK: Emirates Irish liftings jump 65 pct in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Emirates Irish liftings jump 65 pct in 1996/97.

text.p: Cargo carried by Emirates Sky Cargo from the UK increased by 21 percent in the year to end-March whilst that flown ex-Ireland jumped by 65 percent, said Ray Disson Emirates cargo manager for the UK and Ireland.
Last week Emirates in Dubai reported a 23 percent rise to 160,257 tonnes increase in global cargo traffic cargo in the year to end-March.
"It was satisfying to see strong increases to all destinations (from the UK), often despite cheaper rates being offered by competitors, proving that good, reliable service is valued," said Disson.
The sharp increase in cargo lifted from Ireland was mainly made up with hi-tech goods, Disson said. Emirates ex-Ireland cargo is trucked to Manchester.

In particular traffic from the UK to Johannesburg, Nairobi and Moroni more than doubled. Disson said cigarettes were partially responsible for the five fold increase in the still modest tonnage flown to Moroni last year.

From June one, Emirates will fly daily ex-Manchester flights with non-stop flights on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday and fly via Zurich on the other days. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
